##


Release Note : UPI AutoPay | Pre-Debit Notification (PDN) – debit_date enhancements


####


Deployment Date : 19th November 2026


We’ve made enhancements to our UPI AutoPay Pre-Debit Notifications (PDNs). These changes are now live in production.


1.


T+2 / T+3 PDNs: presentation window starts at 00:00 on the debit date.


1. For PDNs sent for T+2 day or T+3 day,` debit_date` is now midnight (00:00:00) of the debit date. It no longer carries the time of day when the PDN was created.
**Example** : Pre Debit Notification created on 20 Nov at 2:48 PM for a 22 Nov debit →` debit_date` = 22 Nov 2026, 00:00:00 (previously 22 Nov, 2:48 PM)
2. This applies to the Pre Debit Notification Callback and the Get Pre Debit Notification Status API.
3. T+1 Pre Debit Notifications (raised 1 day before the debit) are unchanged.


2.


` debit_date` removed from FAILED Pre Debit Notification callbacks:


1. When notification_status is FAILED, the callback no longer includes` debit_date` . A failed Pre Debit Notifications can’t be used for a presentation, so we have removed this filed from the callback in case of failed Pre Debit Notification.
2. All other fields in the failure callback stay the same.
3. Successful Pre Debit Notifications callbacks still include` debit_date` , with no change.


Action required :
Make sure your Pre Debit Notification callback handler doesn’t fail when` debit_date` is missing from FAILED callbacks. If your code reads this field directly or checks callbacks against a strict schema, please make the required changes.


For any further assistance, please reach out to us.
